name: Naranjito (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Orange field crossed by two narrow green stripes near the top and bottom, the orange for the little orange tree of the town's name and the green for its mountains.
history: Naranjito is a town and municipality of Puerto Rico located in the central region of the island, south of Toa Alta; north of Barranquitas and Comerío; east of Corozal; and west of Bayamón.
